svg.title: Impact, by the numbers
svg.desc: 600+ REST endpoints in a production parking SaaS: bookings, refunds, vendor payouts (GoParkEasy · parking SaaS); 57 collections, 6 user roles (GoParkEasy · data model); 3 BullMQ queues, auto-retry (GoParkEasy · queues); 0 client polling: live spot updates over Redis Streams + Socket.io (GoParkEasy · real-time); 2 cache tiers: Redis + LRU (GoParkEasy · caching); <100ms voice-agent replies (Applied AI · voice)
